test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 22 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Identify the correct form of the verb:

"Special children are those who __ physical, emotional, or learning differences that make their development unique."
solution:
The correct answer is '**have**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence uses the plural subject "**Special children**," which requires the plural form of the verb "to have" in the present tense.
 
• The word "**who**" is a relative pronoun referring to "Special children," so the following verb must agree with that plural antecedent.
 
• The passage is written in the **Simple Present Tense** to describe general facts and definitions.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"Special children are those who **have**__ physical, emotional, or learning differences that make their development unique."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "has"** is the singular form of the verb and would be used if the subject were "A special child."
 
• **Option 3: "had"** is the past tense form and does not match the present tense context of the passage ("are," "make").
 
• **Option 4: "having"** is a present participle and cannot function as the main verb of the relative clause without an auxiliary verb.
